fullContentHtml:
UPPSC PCS 2025 Interview Schedule - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has released the interview schedule for the Combined State Upper Subordinate Services Examination 2025. This recruitment was released for 210 posts. Applications for the UPPSC Pre Recruitment 2025 were accepted from February 20, 2025, to April 02, 2025. The interview examination s going to conducted on 28 September 2026 to 24 October 2026. Candidates who have applied for this mains form can download their UPPSC PCS Interview Schedule 2026 from the link given below.
